sources.ref: Walkplay Android app 2.3.1 (com.ttgk.musicbox): its product catalog, kept in data/catalogs/walkplay.json

meta.notes: The vendor and product id pairs Walkplay's product catalog lists under SchemeNo15 (data/catalogs/walkplay.json; this match is generated from it, D51), followed by what only devicePEQ 0617f38 lists: the scheme's product ids under the five vendor ids the catalog never names (most of those pairs don't exist). A device with its own profile matches that instead of this group. Walkplay's app gives this scheme 8 bands of PK, LS, HS, HP and LP; devicePEQ gives it 8 bands of PK, LS and HS.
